source:
A game where everyone is an Animal and they can turn to any Animal they want. And it's gonna be a roleplay game so there should be a lot of clothes, accessories, and other to wear in button that has a text called "closet" to customize (the button is located at the top right corner), you can also changer your fur color, eye color, basically you can change every part of your body to what color you like! Even the clothes! You can change your ear type, mouth, tail if you want it fluffy or whatever you want, and basically everything too! There should also be a button under the "closet" button called "Animals", so you can choose any animal in the world! Even rare breeds for the Animals like a Khao Manee for cats and Ayam Cemani for Chickens! To pick your breed, the player should click the Animal they want to be and then they can pick the breed they wanted! The game should be VERY VERY DETAILED. No bugs, no lags, and there should be a button called "Settings" if the person want music in the background, sound effects, brightness of the game, invite friends, donate robux to the game, and even if they want to play low quality, normal quality and high quality! For new player, they will start with a cat (they can change it if they want to at the "Animals" button), and with normal quality.

For the map, it should be beautiful and very detailed, there should be a button called "Teleport" under the "Settings" Button so the player can teleport to the City, Forest, Jungle, Desert, Beach, Plains, Farm, Mountain, Snow place, And Rain forest!

answers.ask: Realistic nature, or a soft stylised look for the biomes?
answers.answer: Use a soft stylised look for the biomes, while keeping them beautiful and very detailed for roleplay.

answers.ask: Should the ten biomes be one connected world you can walk between, or separate places only reachable by teleport?
answers.answer: Make them separate places reached through the Teleport button, so each detailed biome can load smoothly without lag.

scene_prompt: Create a beautiful, highly detailed animal roleplay world in a soft stylised visual style, with ten separate teleport-accessed biome maps: City, Forest, Jungle, Desert, Beach, Plains, Farm, Mountain, Snow place, and Rain forest. Each biome is a self-contained, immersive environment designed for animal-scale exploration and roleplay, with distinct terrain, vegetation, natural landmarks, and appropriate built structures where relevant; the City includes streets and buildings, while the Farm includes cultivated fields and farm structures. Keep the biomes separate rather than physically connected.

## Genre
The genre is Roleplay & Avatar Sim, specifically open-ended animal roleplay and exploration.

## Shape and preset
Use `world-chaptered`: ten genuinely separate biome maps reached by teleport, not one connected surface. This comes from outside the genre’s usual shapes and replaces the Animal Sim preset’s `wilderness-open`, while retaining the Animal Sim preset because its animal-scale wilderness roleplay remains the clear concept.

## Config requirements
Use `teleporter-link` for visually readable arrival landmarks in every biome; `landmark-focal` for a distinct natural or built orientation anchor in each map; `path-street` for animal-scale circulation, becoming city streets, farm tracks, and natural trails elsewhere; `settlement-density` for the City’s built-up street-and-building fabric; `terrain-relief` for the Mountain and other biome-specific landforms; and `water-body` for the Beach shoreline. Teleport links are a both-stream requirement.

## Layout requirements
Place ten `teleporter-link` arrival endpoints, exactly one in a safe central entry area of each named biome, with each endpoint paired to the shared teleport destination system. No other invisible gameplay markers are required by the brief.

## Layout components
Build ten self-contained maps: City, Forest, Jungle, Desert, Beach, Plains, Farm, Mountain, Snow place, and Rain forest. Each needs a central arrival area, readable animal-scale paths, distinct ground and vegetation, and a memorable orientation landmark. The City uses streets among dense exterior buildings; the Farm uses cultivated field blocks, tracks, and farm structures; the Beach meets a real shoreline; the Mountain carries the strongest elevation. Each map has a closed scenic boundary suitable to its biome, and each composition frames its arrival point against its landmark.

## Render order
Use `isometric`: render each biome’s styled isometric first and derive its top-down plan from that authoritative image because no single-map topology is structurally constrained.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
The scale is huge because it contains ten detailed maps. The theme is soft-stylised, beautiful, detailed nature at animal scale. Use `P4` because the biomes are separate maps, `tiered` for mountain relief without required overhangs, and `CHECK` for the Beach water play envelope.
